decision.summary: A sharp, multi-axis drop centered at ~618–622 is observed in N/E/U with sustained offset through 625. The onset is abrupt and coherent across axes, but the return is unobserved within the allowed context (ends at 660), so the interval is classified as uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed inside [580,660]; the broader uplift starting ~565 lies outside the allowed context and is not evaluated here.
